body: I was recently banned from the server for '' combat logging '' is that the place where I live, the internet is the worst, and the connection is lost every 5 minutes, I demand that you take me the ban server because it is not my fault that the internet is lost every time. replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hello Sta26.


Here is the evidence of you Combat Logging in-game:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LNM75tOaw9Q

The evidence shows the opposite of what you claimed which is you losing connection but instead, the video shows you leaving the game using the command "/leave" when you were hit into the void.


Sincerely,

Edans.
